form.balanceEndReal: Closing balance on the bank statement

form.linesInvalid: Add at least one line (up to 500 lines).

reconcile.title: Reconcile a line
reconcile.lineHint: Choose the open entries this amount covers.
reconcile.proposalsHint: Open entries on the side of the amount's direction, exact matches first.
reconcile.noProposals: There are no open entries to suggest for this line.
reconcile.writeOffHint: A difference remains after the selected entries. Choose an account to take it and complete the reconciliation.
reconcile.confirmHint: The reconciliation is created as soon as you confirm and cannot be undone from here.
reconcile.doneHint: No action is needed on this line.

import.title: Import a bank statement
import.tooLarge: The file is larger than 2 MB.
import.hasHeader: The first row is a header
import.rowCount: {count} row in the file | {count} rows in the file
import.mappingHint: Choose the date, the reference and either one amount column or both debit and credit.
import.rowErrors: {count} row cannot be read | {count} rows cannot be read
import.skipDuplicates: Skip lines the journal already holds
import.mismatch: The opening balance plus the lines gives {expected}, not the closing balance entered.

auto.found: {matched} line can be matched with certainty; {review} need a person | {matched} lines can be matched with certainty; {review} need a person
auto.applied: {matched} line matched; {review} left for review | {matched} lines matched; {review} left for review
auto.failed: {count} line was refused and left open | {count} lines were refused and left open

undo.hint: The line becomes open again; the entries made for it follow the journal's reconcile mode.

errors.notBalanced: The selected entries do not cover the line's amount. Choose an account for the difference or change the selection.
errors.invalidState: This line is already reconciled or cannot be reconciled.
errors.periodLocked: The accounting period is locked for this date.
errors.invalidRows: The file has rows that cannot be read. Preview it to see which.
errors.duplicateLines: The journal already holds some of these lines. Skip them or remove them from the file.
errors.balanceMismatch: The opening balance plus the lines is not the closing balance.
errors.hasReconciliations: Some lines are reconciled. Undo their matches first, then delete the statement.

delete.hint: Its lines are removed with it. A statement with a reconciled line cannot be deleted: undo those matches first.
